name: @thetis/skills-hybrid
description: One brief per skill always in the prompt, a few cards retrieved for the conversation by dense and lexical ranking fused, pinned once, and skill_search for the rest.

fusionWeight.help: The dense share in the rank fusion: 0 is lexical only, 1 is dense only.

denseThreshold.help: The cosine a skill's vector must reach against the query's before the dense list counts it; below it a skill is pinned only when the words match. 0 keeps every dense hit. skill_search ignores it.

minTerms.help: How many distinct words of the first message a skill's text must carry before the words alone pin it; its name or a tag present whole is enough on its own. skill_search ignores it.

pinLimit.help: How many retrieved skills are pinned for the conversation; 0 pins nothing.

pinBodies.help: Pin the bodies of the retrieved skills instead of their cards; costs bytes, saves a round trip.

embeddings.help: The vector source, an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint: baseUrl (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1), apiKey (without one the ranking is lexical), model (openai/text-embedding-3-small) and dimensions (1536).

tools.name: skill_search
tools.description: Search the installed skills by what you are trying to do and get the best matches, one line each with the id. The cards in your prompt were chosen from the first message only: search when the task at hand is not covered by a skill you can see, then skill_fetch the id.

query.description: What you are trying to do, in a sentence: the words a person would use to ask for it.

k.description: How many matches to return. Default 5, at most 20.
